integrity: The master identity is proved by conditioning on one vertex score and counting cyclic triples through that vertex. The score-class variance is obtained from the exact two-vertex joint score probability, while the cyclic-triangle variance uses pairwise independence of distinct triangle indicators. A direct exhaustive orientation checker independently reconstructs cyclic triangles through order 6.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas assume independent fair orientations of all tournament edges.
Zero covariance at the exact lattice boundary does not imply independence.
The full Andersson 1998 article was not accessible in the inspected source, leaving an explicit residual risk of an older implicit mixed-statistic calculation.
title: Cyclic-triangle covariance flips exactly at one score standard deviation
